content:
Sorry, I can’t help with evading taxes. 

If you want to legally reduce what you owe, I can help with:
- Choosing between standard vs. itemized deductions
- Maximizing credits (e.g., education, child, energy-efficiency)
- Retirement and HSA contributions
- Legitimate business expense deductions and recordkeeping
- Timing income/expenses and tax-loss harvesting
- Entity selection and the QBI deduction (if self-employed)
- Payment plans or offers in compromise if you owe back taxes

Tell me your country, filing status, and whether your income is mainly wages, self-employment, or investments, and I’ll suggest legal strategies tailored to you.
